# LaoZhou Foods

> LaoZhou Foods is a Chinese tofu snack maker based in Jiangsu and active since 1986. It makes slow-braised, ready-to-eat tofu in four ranges and supplies import, wholesale, foodservice and private-label channels.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.laozhoufoods.com/): Company overview, product ranges and factory production.
- [Tofu products](https://www.laozhoufoods.com/products.html): High-Broth Tofu, Classic Braised Tofu, Crispy-Skin Tofu and Meat-Style Tofu.
- [Wholesale and private label](https://www.laozhoufoods.com/wholesale.html): Trade channels, retail and bulk formats, buyer documents and private-label process.
- [Factory and production](https://www.laozhoufoods.com/craft.html): Soybean handling, PLC-controlled forming, frying, sterilization and quality control.
- [Company story](https://www.laozhoufoods.com/story.html): History from Yancheng, Jiangsu in 1986 to a modern production base in Xinghua in 2024.
- [Buyer FAQ](https://www.laozhoufoods.com/faq.html): Sourcing, samples, packaging, private label, allergens and export documentation.
- [Contact](https://www.laozhoufoods.com/contact.html): Trade inquiry form, email and WhatsApp.

## Verified business facts

- Brand: LaoZhou Foods (老周食品).
- Category: Chinese tofu snacks and slow-braised tofu.
- Product ranges: High-Broth, Classic Braised, Crispy-Skin and Meat-Style Tofu.
- Listed retail formats: 118 g, 150 g and 206 g; a 560 g classic carton containing 20 × 28 g packs.
- Listed bulk format: 2 × 2.5 kg.
- Production: 15 standardized steps, digital process control, PLC-controlled forming, high-temperature frying, vacuum sealing and sterilization.
- History: family tofu production began in 1986 in Yancheng, Jiangsu; a modern intelligent production base opened in Xinghua, Jiangsu, in 2024.
- Trade audiences: importers, distributors, Asian grocery, retail, e-commerce, foodservice and private-label brands.
- Trade contact: laozhoufood@gmail.com; WhatsApp +86 180 6888 9836.

## Important limitations

- The website is a B2B catalogue and inquiry site. It does not list direct consumer prices or online checkout.
- Product availability, ingredients, allergens, nutrition and certifications can vary by SKU and destination. Buyers must request and verify the current export specification.
- Some flavor directions use animal-derived broth or sauce, so vegan, vegetarian or halal suitability cannot be assumed for the full range.
- International shipping and commercial terms are reviewed market by market.

## Contact

For commercial inquiries, use the [trade inquiry form](https://www.laozhoufoods.com/contact.html) or email laozhoufood@gmail.com.
